questionText: You want to make sure your laptop computer can run a new software application. The following table describes the application system requirements: Minimum - 64-bit dual core 2Ghz CPU with SSE2 support, 4 GB RAM, 1280x720 display, Graphics card with 1 GB RAM; Recommended - 64-bit quad core CPU, 16 GB RAM, 1366x768 display, Graphics card with 4 GB RAM; Optimal - 64-bit eight core CPU, 32 GB RAM, 1920x1080 display, Graphics card with 12 GB RAM. The laptop has the following specifications: 64-bit dual core 2Ghz CPU with SSE2 support, 32 GB RAM, 1920x1080 display, Graphics card with 2 GB RAM. Which statement is correct?

options.text: This laptop meets the optimal system requirements
This laptop meets the recommended system requirements
This laptop meets the minimum system requirements
This laptop exceeds the optimal system requirements
This laptop does not meet the minimum system requirements

questionText: You customize your installation of Google Chrome. You are unhappy with some of the changes. You need to return Google Chrome to its default state by using only one command in the Settings menu shown. Note: You might need to scroll to see the entire menu. Which command should you select?

questionText: Your class recently completed group projects. You are preparing a presentation about your group’s project. Your group will deliver your presentation live, and it will be live streamed for remote viewers. You need to ensure that the remote audience watches and listens to your presentation. Which two actions will increase the audience engagement during your presentation? (Choose 2.)

options.text: Encourage participation with polls or questions requiring virtual hand-raising.
Have group members take turns presenting information
Clearly read aloud the content of each presentation slide.

questionText: Your school asks you to design a website to track participation in student clubs. You gather your team to generate ideas to solve the problem. Which two actions will help the idea-generation process? (Choose 2.)

options.text: Withhold criticism of your peers' ideas
Limit each team member to one or two ideas
Focus only on realistic and practical ideas
Only share ideas you're very confident about

questionText: You are a member of a student team that is creating a website for a local volunteer organization. After your last meeting with the client, the client told your teacher that your team needs to improve its communication skills. Which two actions can you take to improve your communication skills? (Choose 2.)

options.text: Have another team member take over the communication at the next meeting
When the client asks questions, summarize the question before you answer
Text the client to apologize for your poor communication
When talking with the client, speak in a positive, respectful tone
Prepare a written script for all future meetings

questionText: You have just graduated with a degree in Information Technology and hired as a member of an IT Department within a large corporation. How can you keep your digital knowledge current? Select Yes if the action will help keep your digital knowledge current or No if it will not.

statements.text: Volunteer to sit on the advisory board of a non-profit organization.
Talk to experienced colleagues about new technologies.
Read weekly technology newsfeeds related to your field.
